अब्धि अब्-धि, इस्, m. (fr. अप् and rt. धा), a
pond, lake; the ocean; sometimes used to denote the
numerals 4 or (?) 7.
—अब्धि-कफ, अस्, m. cuttle
fish bone, being considered as the forth of the sea.
—अब्धि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born in the ocean; (औ),
m. the अश्विन्स्; (आ), f. spirituous liquor.
—अब्धि-
झष, अस्, m. a sea-fish.
—अब्धि-द्वीपा, f, earth;
an island surrounded by the ocean.
—अब्धि-नगरी,
f., N. of Dvārakā, the capital of Kriṣṇa.
—अब्धि-न-
वनीतक, अस्, m. the moon.
—अब्धि-फेन, अस्, m.
cuttle fish bone.
—अब्धि-मण्डूकी, f. the pearl oyster.
—अब्धि-शयम्न, अस्, m., N. of Viṣṇu, sleeping
on the ocean at the periods of the destruction and
renovation of the world.
—अब्धि-सार, अस्, m. a
gem.
—अब्ध्य-अग्नि, इस्, m. submarine fire.
